request.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a sophisticated, complete Chinese procurement-behavior analytics page for the Client Reach AI B2B customer acquisition CRM. This is image 4 of one coherent five-page interface series. Full-screen flat front-facing application screenshot, 16:9 landscape, designed for 1920x1080, rendered at high resolution with exceptionally crisp readable Chinese. No device frame, no perspective, no promotional slogan.

EXACT SHARED STYLE: refined light business UI with #F5F7F8 canvas, white analytics panels, #E5EBED hairline borders, #182329 graphite text, #718087 secondary text, restrained #168D81 teal accent, muted blue and amber only for supporting series. Chinese typography resembles Microsoft YaHei / Source Han Sans, numerals like Inter. Unified 8px cards and 6px buttons, thin icons, extremely soft shadows, precise grid and generous interior spacing. Rich useful data with calm whitespace. No neon, no gradient backgrounds, no excessive tiles, no 3D charts.

SHARED SHELL: 176px pale left sidebar with teal geometric logo and "Client Reach", subtitle "AI 获客工作台". Navigation "工作台", "采购情报", "客户画像", "采购分析", "上下游关系", divider, "客户线索", "产品知识库", "设置"; "采购分析" selected. Avatar "林亦 · 销售经理" at bottom. 64px header breadcrumb "采购分析 / 华辰电子科技有限公司", search and "演示数据 · 2026-10-08" top right.

PAGE HEADER: "采购行为分析", subtitle "华辰电子科技有限公司 · 从公开记录理解采购节奏". Right date selector "2025-10 至 2026-09", category selector "全部品类", outlined "导出分析". Small clear neutral note "统计口径：公开成交样本，非企业采购全量". A slim four-metric strip: "样本成交金额 ¥1,500 万", "公开成交 48 笔", "合作供应商 8 家", "典型交付期 14–21 天". Metric numbers medium large and elegant with tiny indicators, without huge empty colored cards.

CHART ROW ONE: broad 1080px panel "月度采购金额与笔数" and adjacent 520px panel "采购品类结构". Main chart is a clean dual-series visualization: teal area-and-line with 12 clear dots, thin blue-gray columns for transaction count, only faint horizontal grid, labels in 万元, direct annotation "季末采购集中" near a peak. X axis exact month labels "10月", "11月", "12月", "1月", "2月", "3月", "4月", "5月", "6月", "7月", "8月", "9月". Monthly amount values: 76,88,96,122,109,131,142,137,128,156,144,171; they sum to 1,500. Count columns: 2,3,3,4,3,4,5,4,4,5,5,6; total 48. Legible legend "成交金额" / "样本笔数". On right a restrained multi-tone teal/blue donut with center "公开样本" and legend "PCB 42%", "连接器 28%", "电子元件 18%", "其他 12%"; include small direct values "630 万", "420 万", "270 万", "180 万". All pieces coherent.

CHART ROW TWO: two compact panels. Left "供应商集中度" with horizontal bars "鼎芯电路 34%", "联科连接器 26%", "恒越电子 18%", "其他供应商 22%"; small label "前三家占 78%". Right "采购节奏与机会" has a refined 12-month heatmap/calendar indicating Q4 and quarter ends, and three concise AI insight rows "季末补货更集中", "连接器可切入第二供应商", "建议准备 3 档阶梯报价". Small amber caption "AI 推断 · 需结合销售访谈核实". Avoid irrelevant radar charts.

BOTTOM: a useful compact sample table "近期公开成交样本" with columns "物料", "供应商", "数量", "成交单价", "成交日期", "来源". Three sample rows:
"HDI PCB" / "鼎芯电路" / "50 万片" / "¥1.08 / 片" / "2026-09-16" / "合同公示";
"板端连接器" / "联科连接器" / "80 万件" / "¥0.36 / 件" / "2026-08-22" / "成交公告";
"电子元件" / "恒越电子" / "120 万件" / "未披露" / "2026-07-12" / "成交公告".
Missing price displays "未披露" rather than zero. The table is clean, with restrained source links and no dense tiny text. A small row "年度采购全量：待补充" at footer makes the scope honest. All amounts and relationships are demo data. Composition must feel like a finished intelligent business tool with rich actionable analysis and excellent legibility.

warnings: 第 1 张实际尺寸 1672x941 与请求 3840x2160 不一致。
